I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message. The ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **#4092**.

Ilse posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. I also passed along Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

Dana told me in a private message that she guesses the ticket will become OPS-5546 next year. I left that out of the channel reply, as she asked.
